info.name: Group Photo Sorter
info.summary: Collect, auto-convert, and organize photos/videos from shared upload links
info.description: A Nextcloud app that allows you to generate secure, shareable upload links. Guests can upload photos and videos anonymously. The app automatically: - Converts images (HEIC, RAW, PNG, TIFF, WebP) to standard JPEG. - Converts videos (MOV, AVI, MKV, HEVC, WebM) to optimized MP4. - Renames files using EXIF/metadata creation dates + event name. - Automatically handles filename conflicts. - Stores everything directly in your Nextcloud folders. - Keeps track of upload statistics with GDPR compliance (IP anonymization). - Uses Nextcloud's built-in caches (Redis/Memcached) for rate limiting and lock management.
info.author: Florian Schlösser
